summary: v11.0.14.02 Enterprise Web Release: Credit & Debit Note Inventory Stock Adjustment & Barcode Studio Actions Parity
highlights: 1. Credit & Debit Note Inventory Reversal: Integrated item-level selection (itemId, itemCode, quantity, rate) for accurate stock adjustment in item_master via CreditDebitNoteService.
2. Dynamic Invoice & Bill Item Pickers: Added real-time cascading lookup from closed customer sales and vendor purchase orders.
3. Barcode Studio Actions Menu: Aligned top toolbar with canonical purple Actions dropdown menu matching desktop layout.
